facades.name: north (IJhaven quay): warehouse, wings and the bar
facades.note: Commons 2007 view from the Java-eiland (public domain), checked against w01-16 (2021) and w01-16.alt (2020). Bands from the quay: ground = 5 window pairs (10) + 4 arched loggia doors + 2 windows on each wing; storeys 1-4 = 10 twin windows + 4 loggia doors + 4 wing windows; the recessed glass storey under the bar is one ribbon; the bar has 4 rows of 7 ribbon bays (narrower end bays). One small plant box shows on the bar's roof (gables 1). depthBand 13 m: the recessed storey stands 10 m behind the quay front.

facades.name: south (Piet Heinkade): the two arms of the U and the courtyard frame
facades.note: w02-196 (2020-04-22). Ground storey hidden by cars, trees and the van: null. Storey 1: two ribbon bays per arm plus the seven glass panes of the courtyard frame between its 0.5 m posts (separate openings by the ribbon convention); storeys 2-10: two ribbon bays on each arm's 14.8 m street face (the deep courtyard balconies are not counted).
